parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The programming language of the application.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: SentinelEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to start the switch.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The service where the application is deployed. A value of ACK indicates Container Service for Kubernetes.

parameters.name: SwitchEnable
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-application --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace prod --app-name spring-cloud-a --source ACK --biz-language JAVA --sentinel-enable true --switch-enable true --tags Value=tagKey Key=tagKey --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Language JAVA --SwitchEnable true --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace prod --Source ACK --Tags '[{"Value":"tagKey","Key":"tagKey"}]' --AppName 'spring-cloud-a' --SentinelEnable true
